text:
tess_sales: Quick triage Velora POC blocked by signature routing. They have two contracting entities and DocuSign keeps rejecting the second signer (role/email mismatch). Customer wants Net45 and EU HSM keys. Need a fast workaround so infra can spin up test cluster this week.

signing-bot: system: envelope validation failed (ROLE_EMAIL_MISMATCH)
```
recipient role 'EntityB_Signer' expected email 'ops@velora.eu' got 'ops+1@velora.eu'
POST /v2/envelopes/validate
```
tess_sales: @omar_procure @hana_legal any short path?

omar_procure: PO route works for provisioning. Finance needs PO#, billing contact, and an MSA reference (env ID or MSA date). If they can send a PO today we can put provisioning on Net45 hold and start infra.

hana_legal: For POC we can accept a primary-signed MSA + a one-page consent from the secondary entity that references the OrderForm and PO#. I'll draft a tight consent template (POC-only, no waivers). ETA: 6h.

liam_eng: Tech can issue temporary scoped API keys and a subaccount so they can run the POC before full signatures. We just need written acknowledgement (email) and a PO#. If DocuSign is failing, we can also split into two envelopes and add cross-reference text in the orderform.

nina_billing: HSM fee = +15% surcharge. Invoice must show line: "EU HSM (monthly)" and reference both envelope IDs or both PO numbers. We can combine into one invoice if both refs present.

tess_sales: OK I'll ask Velora for the PO and exact signer emails. Hana pls send the consent template and HSM addendum to procurement@velora.com and cc billing@redwood.com. Liam, stand by for reprovision.

hana_legal: Sending now. Consent snippet will include: "Entity B consents to the OrderForm executed by Entity A for POC purposes only; this consent does not substitute for a countersigned MSA for production."

liam_eng: CLI helper if you need to resend with exact role mapping:
```
docusign-cli envelopes create --template tpl_velora_v1 --roles '[{"roleName":"EntityA_Signer","email":"ceo@velora.com"},{"roleName":"EntityB_Signer","email":"ops@velora.eu"}]'
```

omar_procure: I'll monitor PO. If no PO in 48h escalate to AE.

tess_sales: Target: POC live by Friday. Updating Velora now.
